zh.title: 亞馬遜暫停21 Air運營 邁阿密767衝出跑道釀5死
zh.summary: 亞馬遜暫停21 Air運營；邁阿密767貨機衝出跑道致5死5傷；NTSB初步數據顯示著陸速度過快
body: 亞馬遜公司於2026年9月13日發布聲明，決定暫停與貨運承運人21 Air的合作關係，此舉緊隨9月6日發生在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）的波音767貨機衝出跑道事故。該事故造成地面5人死亡、5人受傷。
亞馬遜發言人Kelly Nantel在聲明中表示，公司自事故發生以來一直配合調查並審視相關情況，隨後決定「暫停我們與21 Air的運營，該承運人執行7598號班機」。亞馬遜強調此為商業決策，並非監管行動，雙方均未將此舉與調查發現掛鉤。
根據國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）於9月9日發布的初步調查更新，7598號班機為從聖胡安（SJU）飛往邁阿密的第121部定期貨運航班。飛行數據記錄器顯示，飛機前輪及右主輪以158節地速接地，剎車於146節施行，左主輪於134節接地。隨後剎車於120節釋放，油門推進至復飛推力設定，旋即拉回怠速並再次施行剎車，最終記錄地速65節。NTSB指出無跡象顯示速度剎車或反推裝置曾展開。
駕駛艙語音記錄器捕捉到機師在錄音結束前約1分40秒首次警告飛機速度過快，並持續重複該憂慮，但無一致口頭回應。NTSB強調兩份記錄器摘要均屬初步性質，可能變更。
事故機型為波音767-300貨機，屬21 Air執飛的亞馬遜航空航班。著陸跑道30後衝出跑道末端，撞擊機場圍牆外公路上的車輛，導致5名地面人員喪生、5人受傷。21 Air總部位於北卡羅來納州格林斯伯勒，自2024年起為亞馬遜航空執飛波音767機隊。
21 Air在聲明中表示正全力協助受害者家屬並配合調查，對其安全政策、程序及訓練充滿信心。亞馬遜航空網絡仍由其他承運商運營，包括Air Transport International、ABX Air、太陽城航空、夏威夷航空、Cargojet、ASL Airlines及Quickjet等，日均超過250班次。
NTSB尚未釐清事故可能原因，調查仍在進行中。亞馬遜未說明暫停合作的具體期限，亦未表明調查結束後是否恢復與21 Air的合作關係。

en.title: Amazon Pauses 21 Air Operations After Deadly Miami 767 Runway Overrun Kills Five
en.summary: Amazon pauses 21 Air operations; Miami 767 overrun kills five on ground; NTSB cites high touchdown speed
body: Amazon announced on September 13, 2026, that it would pause operations with cargo carrier 21 Air following the fatal Boeing 767 freighter runway overrun at Miami International Airport (MIA) on September 6. The accident killed five people on the ground and injured five others.

In a statement, Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nantel said the company had spent the days since the accident supporting the investigation and reviewing surrounding circumstances before deciding to "pause our operations with 21 Air, the operator of Flight 7598." Amazon emphasized the move is a commercial step, not a regulatory action, and neither company has linked it to any investigative finding. Amazon holds no air operator certificate for these flights and purchases lift from certificated carriers such as 21 Air.

According to a National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) investigative update published September 9, Flight 7598 was a Part 121 cargo service from San Juan (SJU) to Miami. Flight data recorder data shows the nose and right main landing gear touched down at a groundspeed of 158 knots, brakes were applied at 146 knots, and the left main gear touched down at 134 knots. Brakes were then released at 120 knots as throttles were advanced to a setting consistent with go-around thrust, before being returned to idle with brakes reapplied at 117 knots. The final recorded groundspeed was 65 knots, with no indication that speed brakes or thrust reversers had deployed.

The cockpit voice recorder captured one pilot warning that the aircraft was too fast approximately one minute and 40 seconds before the recording ended, repeating the concern through to the end with no consistent verbal response. The NTSB described both recorder summaries as preliminary and subject to change.

The aircraft, a Boeing 767-300 freighter operated by 21 Air for Amazon Air, overran Runway 30, breached the airport perimeter, and struck vehicles on a public road. Five people on the ground were killed and five injured. 21 Air, headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, began flying Boeing 767s for Amazon Air in 2024 and also operates for other customers including DHL.

21 Air stated it remains focused on supporting affected families and collaborating with the NTSB and partners, expressing confidence in its safety policies, procedures, and training. Other contracted carriers continue to operate across the Amazon Air Cargo network, which includes more than 100 aircraft flying over 250 daily flights across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and Asia.

The NTSB has not determined the probable cause of the accident. Amazon has not specified the duration of the pause or whether the relationship with 21 Air will resume after the investigation or its own review concludes.

zh.title: 亞馬遜因邁阿密貨機墜毀事故暫停與21航空合作
zh.summary: 亞馬遜因邁阿密墜機釀5死事件；暫停與21航空合作並配合調查
body: 亞馬遜公司（Amazon.com Inc.）表示，鑑於上週末在邁阿密發生的貨機墜毀事故造成5人罹難，已決定暫停與總部位於邁阿密的21航空（21 Air）合作。21航空是一家貨運航空公司，事發時正為亞馬遜旗下的貨運物流網絡亞馬遜航空（Amazon Air）執飛該班失事貨機。
亞馬遜發言人南特爾（Kelly Nantel）在發給路透社的聲明中指出，在上週末發生該起悲慘事件後，亞馬遜配合調查並檢視相關情況，隨後做出暫停與7598號班機營運商21航空合作的決定。南特爾並補充說明，公司將持續協助調查工作，同時全力支援所有受到影響的人員。

官員指出，這架由21航空替亞馬遜航空執飛的貨運班機，在降落於邁阿密國際機場時衝出跑道，並撞上地面的多輛車輛。飛航追蹤網站Flightradar24資料顯示，失事飛機為一架機齡32年的波音767-300型貨機，該機在1994年至2015年間曾擔任多家航空公司之客機。失事前該機正執行當日第3趟飛行任務，自波多黎各首府聖胡安（San Juan）起飛，在此之前已完成辛辛那提至邁阿密及邁阿密至聖胡安的航程。
主導調查此墜機案的美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）表示，根據飛航資料紀錄器的證據，21航空該班機的飛行員在飛機觸地後曾考慮中止降落。此外，NTSB資料亦顯示，在飛機進入降落跑道前1分多鐘，一名飛行員曾提醒同機人員飛機飛行速度過快，飛機最終在降落時衝出跑道。
21航空在發給路透社的聲明中回應，公司目前專注於支援所有受此事故影響的家屬與親人，並在調查進行期間，持續與NTSB及亞馬遜等合作夥伴密切合作。21航空同時強調，對自身的安全政策、作業程序及人員訓練充滿信心。

en.title: Amazon Suspends 21 Air Partnership Following Fatal Miami Cargo Plane Crash
en.summary: Amazon suspends partnership with 21 Air following a fatal cargo plane crash in Miami.
body: Amazon.com Inc. announced that it has suspended its partnership with Miami-based cargo operator 21 Air following a cargo plane crash in Miami last weekend that resulted in five fatalities. 21 Air is a cargo airline that was operating the flight on behalf of Amazon Air, the e-commerce giant's air freight logistics network.

In a statement released to Reuters, Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nantel stated that following the tragic incident last weekend, the company spent time assisting with the investigation and reviewing the relevant circumstances before making the decision to pause cooperation with 21 Air, the operator of Flight 7598. Nantel added that Amazon will continue to cooperate with investigators and support all affected personnel.

According to officials, the cargo flight operated by 21 Air for Amazon Air overran the runway during landing at Miami International Airport and collided with multiple vehicles on the ground. Flight tracking service Flightradar24 recorded that the aircraft was a 32-year-old Boeing 767-300 freighter, which previously operated as a passenger aircraft for several airlines between 1994 and 2015. On the day of the crash, the aircraft was performing its third flight leg, departing from San Juan, Puerto Rico, after earlier flying from Cincinnati to Miami and then to San Juan.

The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), which is leading the investigation into the crash, stated that evidence from the flight data recorder showed the pilots of the 21 Air aircraft considered aborting the landing after touching down. The NTSB also indicated that more than one minute prior to landing on the runway, one pilot had warned that the aircraft was flying too fast before it ultimately overran the runway.

In a statement sent to Reuters, 21 Air expressed that its focus remains on supporting the families and loved ones affected by the accident. The carrier added that it is working closely with the NTSB, Amazon, and other partners as the investigation continues, and maintained confidence in its safety policies, operational procedures, and training programs.

zh.title: 首批2架MQ-9B無人機抵台 花蓮基地完成首飛
zh.summary: 首批兩架MQ-9B無人機運抵台灣，14日於花蓮基地成功完成首次飛行測試。
body: 台灣空軍向美國採購的首批兩架MQ-9B無人機已全數運抵台灣，經由原廠與軍方團隊完成組裝及相關測試後，於2026年9月14日上午首度在空軍花蓮基地升空執行飛行測試。相關人員表示，期望藉由該型無人機的長滯空及全時段監偵能力，進一步強化對台灣海峽周邊海空域動態的即時掌握。
根據國防部預算規劃，空軍共編列新台幣217億元預算，向美國採購4架由通用原子系統公司（General Atomics）製造的MQ-9B無人機，相關系統包含地面控制站等附屬設備。整起採購計畫採用分批交機方式進行，預計於115年及116年陸續交付完成。首批2架無人機先前已於美西時間3月17日在美國順利完成交機程序。
空軍於115年度國防預算書中強調，為了有效掌控周邊海空域動態與兵力異動，極需籌建具備長滯空、日夜間全時段監偵能力的無人機系統。該系統配置即時傳輸鏈路，能有效偵獲周邊影像並即時回傳供情報研判，滿足戰術與戰略情報時效需求。此外，該型高高空無人機亦具備長滯空與酬載能力，可支援防禦作戰並對潛在威脅發揮嚇阻作用。
國防安全研究院學者蘇紫雲指出，MQ-9B無人機在台灣軍方的核心定位為提升戰場偵蒐與情報監偵能力，而非作為主攻武器使用。在常態性戰備時期，面對周邊艦艇與海警船隻的灰色地帶侵擾，MQ-9B能夠提供全天候持續監控功能，有效填補海域偵察空缺並強化防衛體系。

en.title: Taiwan Receives First Two MQ-9B Drones, Conducts Initial Test Flight in Hualien
en.summary: Taiwan receives its first two MQ-9B drones and conducts the initial test flight at Hualien Air Base.
body: Taiwan's Air Force has received its first batch of two MQ-9B unmanned aerial vehicles purchased from the United States. Following assembly and preliminary testing conducted jointly by technical staff from manufacturer General Atomics and the military, the aircraft successfully completed their first test flight at Hualien Air Base on the morning of September 14, 2026. Official sources indicated that the deployment aims to leverage the drone's long endurance and all-weather surveillance capabilities to enhance domain awareness around the Taiwan Strait.

The procurement project is backed by a budget allocation of NT$21.7 billion spanning from 2022 through 2029. Under the agreement, Taiwan is acquiring four MQ-9B drones manufactured by General Atomics, along with associated equipment including ground control stations. The deliveries are structured in two separate tranches of two aircraft each, scheduled for delivery in 2026 and 2027. The first two aircraft formally underwent delivery acceptance procedures in the United States on March 17, US West Coast time.

In defense budget documentation, the Air Force emphasized that establishing a high-altitude unmanned aerial system with persistent day-and-night surveillance capabilities is critical for monitoring regional military movements. The system features real-time data link capabilities to transmit intelligence imagery immediately for tactical analysis. Additionally, the platform's high operational ceiling and long loiter time provide support for defensive operations while reinforcing strategic deterrence.

Defense analyst Su Tzu-yun of the Institute for National Defense and Security Research noted that the MQ-9B's primary role for Taiwan focuses on battlefield intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) rather than offensive strike missions. During routine readiness periods, the system offers continuous monitoring against grey-zone maritime operations, effectively bridging gaps in maritime domain awareness.

zh.title: Frontier Airlines機組員超時 旅客滯留Knoxville
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines航班因天氣轉降及機組員超時，導致旅客滯留過夜。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 13 日的報導，Frontier Airlines 旗下航班因遭遇惡劣天氣影響，被迫改飛轉降至 Knoxville。
航班轉降抵達 Knoxville 後，該航班的機組人員隨即達到法定工時上限，無法於當晚繼續執行後續飛行任務。
受到惡劣天氣導致轉降以及機組人員工時超時的雙重因素影響，航班上的旅客被迫於 Knoxville 滯留過夜。
整起事件起源於天氣因素造成的班機改飛，並因機組員觸及法定工時上限而無法繼續航程，最終造成旅客於該地滯留。

en.title: Frontier Passengers Stranded Overnight in Knoxville After Weather Diversion and Crew Timeout
en.summary: Frontier Airlines passengers were stranded overnight in Knoxville after weather diverted their flight and crew timed out.
body: Frontier Airlines passengers were stranded overnight in Knoxville after severe weather conditions forced their flight to make an unscheduled diversion to the airport.
According to reporting by Simple Flying on September 13, 2026, the diversion occurred after severe weather forced the aircraft to land in Knoxville.
Following the flight's arrival in Knoxville, the flight crew reached its legal duty limit, which prohibited the crew from continuing the flight.
Due to the combination of the weather diversion and the crew reaching its legal duty limit, the passengers remained stranded in Knoxville overnight.

zh.title: OAG與Cirium公布8月航空營運資料 Safair與墨航準點率領先
zh.summary: Safair於8月錄得94%準點率居首；全球航班取消總數較7月減少17%。
body: 根據航空資訊機構OAG公布的2026年8月份航班準點率資料，在暑期旅遊尖峰期間，南非Safair航空展現出優異的營運表現。該航空公司於8月份共營運5,139架次航班，準點率達到94%，且整月僅取消3架次服務。除了Safair之外，日本富士夢幻航空（Fuji Dream Airlines）以93%的準點率緊隨其後，皇家約旦航空（Royal Jordanian）準點率為91%，海灣航空（Gulf Air）則達到90%。
OAG的資料同時顯示，部分航空公司在維持高完成率的同時面臨準點率挑戰。英國休閒航空公司Jet2於8月份營運了16,160架次排定航班，實現零航班取消紀錄，但其航班準點率為60%。希臘SkyExpress航空在營運的6,772架次航班中同樣保持零取消，但準點到達率則為52%。
在歐洲市場方面，斯堪地那維亞航空（Scandinavian Airlines，SAS）成為該區8月份最準點的航空公司，航班準點率達到87%。愛爾蘭航空（Aer Lingus）以83.1%的準點率位居歐洲第二，冰島航空（Icelandair）則以81.7%排名第三。
另一方面，航空資料分析公司Cirium的最新統計顯示，全球航班取消狀況在8月份出現顯著改善。全球航班取消總數由7月份的71,840架次降至8月份的59,785架次，環比減少17%。其中，亞太地區的取消量下降幅度最大，達到23%；北美地區下降20%；中東與非洲地區亦下降15%。相對地，拉丁美洲地區的航班取消量增加34%，歐洲地區則微幅增加0.36%。
在個別航空公司準點率排名中，墨西哥航空（Aeromexico）以89.74%的準點到達率高居全球及拉丁美洲榜首。新加坡航空（Singapore Airlines）則以87.91%的準點率領跑亞太地區。此外，WestJet、SAS與FlySafair分別維持了美洲、歐洲與非洲地區的準點率領先地位。

en.title: Safair and Aeromexico Lead August On-Time Performance as Global Cancellations Fall 17%
en.summary: Safair achieved a 94% on-time performance rate in August; global flight cancellations fell 17% month-over-month.
body: According to official monthly punctuality data published by OAG, South Africa's Safair achieved an on-time performance rate of 94% across 5,139 flights in August, cancelling only three services during the peak summer travel rush. Among other top performers, Japan's Fuji Dream Airlines recorded a 93% on-time performance rate, Royal Jordanian achieved 91%, and Gulf Air registered 90%.

The OAG figures also highlighted carriers that maintained schedules without flight cancellations despite lower punctuality. UK leisure airline Jet2 operated 16,160 scheduled flights in August without a single cancellation, while recording an on-time performance rate of 60%. Similarly, Greece's SkyExpress completed 6,772 flights with zero cancellations and an on-time arrival rate of 52%.

In Europe, Scandinavian Airlines was identified as the region's most punctual carrier for August, delivering an 87% on-time arrival rate across its network. Aer Lingus followed in second place with an 83.1% on-time performance rate, while Icelandair ranked third among European airlines at 81.7%.

Separate industry data released by Cirium revealed a broader global trend of reduced operational disruptions during August. Global flight cancellations dropped by 17% month-over-month, falling from 71,840 in July to 59,785 in August. The Asia-Pacific region recorded the largest reduction in flight cancellations at 23%, followed by North America at 20% and the Middle East and Africa at 15%, whereas cancellations rose by 34% in Latin America and increased by 0.36% in Europe.

Regarding individual regional rankings from Cirium, Aeromexico topped both the global and Latin American on-time arrival charts with an 89.74% rate. Singapore Airlines led the Asia-Pacific region with an on-time arrival rate of 87.91%, while WestJet, Scandinavian Airlines, and FlySafair maintained their respective regional leadership positions across the Americas, Europe, and Africa.
